source.title: Red Bull/WCA Collaboration 2019
source.content:
As informed earlier by the WCA Board, the WCA and Red Bull Mind Gamers have decided to partner together to host joint events in China, Mexico, and Spain this season. The competitions will take place as follows:

1. Madrid, Spain - [UPM Open 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UPMOpen2019) - [Red Bull Qualifier](https://mindgamers.redbull.com/rubiks/event/35) 
2. Shanghai, China - [Shanghai Open 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ShanghaiOpen2019) - [Red Bull Qualifier](https://mindgamers.redbull.com/rubiks/event/31)
3. Edo. México, Mexico - [Misión México 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MisionMexico2019) - [Red Bull Qualifier](https://mindgamers.redbull.com/rubiks/event/42) 

You can learn more about the Red Bull Rubik’s Cube World Cup and their qualifiers [here](https://mindgamers.redbull.com/rubiks).

translation.title: 2019 年红牛与 WCA 合作赛事
translation.content:
如 WCA 董事会此前所通报，WCA 与 Red Bull Mind Gamers 决定在本赛季合作，在中国、墨西哥和西班牙举办联合赛事。具体比赛如下：

1. 西班牙马德里——[UPM Open 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UPMOpen2019)——[红牛资格赛](https://mindgamers.redbull.com/rubiks/event/35)。
2. 中国上海——[Shanghai Open 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ShanghaiOpen2019)——[红牛资格赛](https://mindgamers.redbull.com/rubiks/event/31)。
3. 墨西哥墨西哥州——[Misión México 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MisionMexico2019)——[红牛资格赛](https://mindgamers.redbull.com/rubiks/event/42)。

有关红牛魔方世界杯及其资格赛的更多信息，可在[此处](https://mindgamers.redbull.com/rubiks)了解。
